cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Use extensive Java, Selenium, Rest-Assured, JMeter experience to design and develop Automated Testing solutions
Be a key technical player in contributing to the architecture evolution of our Full-stack Test Automation Frameworks and related capabilities that includes UI, web services automation solutions
Develop and enhance next-generation Enterprise Test Engineering Automation solutions in a Continuous Integration environment (CI/CD pipeline)

Demonstrates advanced analytical skills and debugging and root cause analysis skills

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly

cond_0221.intro: We are looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer to join our team. Most people become stronger in this kind of automation and test engineering work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0221.responsibilities:
Use extensive Java, Selenium, Rest-Assured, JMeter experience to design and develop Automated Testing solutions
Be a key technical player in contributing to the architecture evolution of our Full-stack Test Automation Frameworks and related capabilities that includes UI, web services automation solutions
Develop and enhance next-generation Enterprise Test Engineering Automation solutions in a Continuous Integration environment (CI/CD pipeline)
Define, design, development, documentation, and maintenance of tools and Automation Frameworks for current and next-gen Software Platforms/Frameworks as part of an agile team
Partner with different stakeholders - Product Management, Application Development, DevOps and other Technical teams in planning and coordination
Document and communicate Automation Framework functions, interfaces, performance criteria, test cases and results to diverse audiences
Provide guidance, training, and mentoring of Test Engineers and help with the Transition process of an Enterprise Quality Assurance department to Enterprise Test Engineering department.
Aligns risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
cond_0221.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 8 years of Software Development experience in Test automation.
Experience as Sr. Java Developer/SDET/Test Automation Engineer in the design and development of Applications, Tools or Test Automation Frameworks using any high-level structured programming language.
Advanced Java development skills, understanding of design patterns, data structures, and experience working in a layered architecture with significant experience applying those skills in test environments
Must have a minimum of 4 years hands-on experience in open source tools such as Selenium, TestNG/Junit /Webservice, etc.
Experience in Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery CI/CD technologies (e.g. Jenkins, Git, Maven etc.).
Demonstrates advanced analytical skills and debugging and root cause analysis skills.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Hands-on experience in Development or Test Automation Framework implementations
Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly.
Experience selecting and configuring appropriate tools and frameworks to effectively drive automated testing.
Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. Agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.
Experienced in mentoring more junior Automation engineers and providing guidance as needed.
Demonstrates proficiency in program and quality management, issue management, and communication.

cond_0252.intro: We are looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer to join our team.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Use extensive Java, Selenium, Rest-Assured, JMeter experience to collaborate on designing and developing Automated Testing solutions
Work alongside the team as a key technical contributor to the architecture evolution of our Full-stack Test Automation Frameworks and related capabilities that includes UI, web services automation solutions
Coordinate with the team to develop and enhance next-generation Enterprise Test Engineering Automation solutions in a Continuous Integration environment (CI/CD pipeline)
Share responsibility for the definition, design, development, documentation, and maintenance of tools and Automation Frameworks for current and next-gen Software Platforms/Frameworks as part of an agile team

Document and communicate Automation Framework functions, interfaces, performance criteria, test cases and results to diverse audiences

Hands-on experience in Development or Test Automation Framework implementations
Advanced Java development skills, understanding of design patterns, data structures, and experience working in a layered architecture with significant experience applying those skills in test environments
Must have a minimum of 4 years hands-on experience in open source tools such as Selenium, TestNG/Junit /Webservice, etc.
Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly.
Experience in Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery CI/CD technologies (e.g. Jenkins, Git, Maven etc.).
Experience selecting and configuring appropriate tools and frameworks to effectively drive automated testing.
Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. Agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.

Use extensive Java, Selenium, Rest-Assured, and JMeter experience to design and develop automated testing solutions
Contribute to the architecture evolution of Full-stack Test Automation Frameworks, including UI and web services automation solutions
Develop and enhance next-generation Enterprise Test Engineering Automation solutions within a CI/CD pipeline environment
Define, design, develop, document, and maintain tools and Automation Frameworks for current and next-gen software platforms as part of an agile team
Coordinate with Product Management, Application Development, DevOps, and other technical teams on planning and task-specific deliverables
Document Automation Framework functions, interfaces, performance criteria, test cases, and results, and share with relevant stakeholders
Provide guidance, training, and mentoring to Test Engineers and support the transition of an Enterprise Quality Assurance department to an Enterprise Test Engineering department
Incorporate risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalate appropriately
cond_0628.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
Minimum 8 years of software development experience in test automation
Experience as a Sr. Java Developer, SDET, or Test Automation Engineer in the design and development of applications, tools, or test automation frameworks using a high-level structured programming language
Hands-on experience in development or test automation framework implementations
Advanced Java development skills, understanding of design patterns, data structures, and experience working in a layered architecture with significant experience applying those skills in test environments
Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience with open source tools such as Selenium, TestNG/JUnit, web services, etc.
Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly
Experience with CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, Git, and Maven
Experience selecting and configuring appropriate tools and frameworks for automated testing
Good understanding of automation's role in various SDLCs (e.g., agile, scrum, waterfall)
Experience mentoring junior automation engineers and providing guidance on technical tasks
Strong analytical, debugging, and root cause analysis skills
Proficiency in program and quality management, issue management, and written communication
cond_0628.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
